cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Of course your brother can stay for dinner. I'll give him my pie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Please don't worry. There are peas, and I had a substantial breakfast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order you a pizza. It takes forty minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How thoughtful. I'll keep everyone company while they eat, then you can all watch me have dinner at nine.

mechanism: A graciously approves accommodation for an extra diner while making the personal cost of each approved solution increasingly visible.
confusable: D21 becomes furious while helping; D45 remains gracious, emphasizing inconvenience rather than rage or direct apology demands.
comparison: Delayed personal dinner under public observation differs from carrying a heavy bag over extra station stairs.
seedUse: Use D45-a surrendered pie and delayed pizza solution, with S01 permission shaping gracious acceptance of the growing sacrifice.
